{{Quote|Attack Pattern Delta. Go now.|Luke Skywalker, during the Battle of Hoth|<ref name="ESB" />}}
'''Attack Pattern Delta''' was one of three [[Rogue Doctrine]] attack formations developed by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] tactician [[Beryl Chiffonage]],<ref name="RASB" /> with help from [[Risiev Credal]],<ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref> for use by the [[Snowspeeder/Legends|snowspeeders]] stationed at [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].<ref name="RASB" />

[[File:Attack_Pattern_Delta_TCG.png|thumb|left|200px|Attack Pattern Delta in action]]
Skywalker and Chiffonage knew they would be facing [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Walker/Legends|walkers]] in the upcoming battle after the Rebel base had been discovered. However, until the actual thick of combat, the fact that the armor of an [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-AT]] [[Walker/Legends|walker]] was too strong for the snowspeeders' laser cannons was unknown.<ref name="GG3-2">[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back'', Second Edition]]</ref>

The tactic consisted of a formation of snowspeeders approaching the enemy walkers in a single-file formation to give the enemy a single target. When the speeders reached optimal firing range, the lead speeder would fire before peeling off in one direction. While an AT-AT could only track a single speeder, the rest of the [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] would be able to approach relatively safely, each with a clear shot before parting in different directions. This tactic was used to great effect against the AT-ATs during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]].<ref name="GG3-2" />

In [[24 ABY/Legends|24 ABY]] it was also used by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] in the [[Battle of the Emperor's Plague Storehouse]].<ref name="EP">''[[Young Jedi Knights: The Emperor's Plague]]''</ref>
